label: Session Method
description: Calls a documented method on the shared ThunderPHP Core\Session object.

properties.name: result_variable
properties.label: Result variable
properties.help: Optional PHP variable name. Omit the $ sign. Leave blank to use the automatic node-specific name.

methods.name: set
methods.label: Set Session Data
methods.description: Stores a session value by key or stores several values from an associative array.
methods.help:
Stores a session value by key or stores several values from an associative array.

### Example

```php
$session->set('username', 'john');

$session->set([
    'email' => 'john@example.com',
    'role' => 'admin',
]);
```

### Notes

- Pass a key and value, or pass an associative array as the first argument.
- Nested values can be written with dot notation such as `cart.items`.

methods.name: get
methods.label: Get Session Data
methods.description: Retrieves a session value and returns the supplied fallback when the key is unavailable.
methods.help:
Retrieves a session value and returns the supplied fallback when the key is unavailable.

### Example

```php
$username = $session->get('username', 'guest');
$total = $session->get('cart.summary.total', 0);
```

### Notes

- Dot notation can read nested values.
- The fallback is returned when the key is unavailable.

methods.name: has
methods.label: Has Session Key
methods.description: Checks whether a session key exists.

methods.name: remove
methods.label: Remove Session Data
methods.description: Removes a session value by key.
methods.help:
Removes a session value by key.

### Example

```php
$session->remove('username');
```

### Notes

- This targets one key rather than clearing the complete application session.

methods.name: pop
methods.label: Pop Session Value
methods.description: Pulls a value from session using the class pop helper.
methods.help:
Pulls a value from session using the class pop helper.

### Example

```php
$message = $session->pop('notice');
```

### Notes

- Use this for one-time data that should be pulled from session rather than repeatedly read.

methods.name: push
methods.label: Append to Session Array
methods.description: Appends a value to an array stored in session.
methods.help:
Appends a value to an array stored in session.

### Example

```php
$session->push('notifications', 'New message');

$session->push('cart.items', [
    'id' => 1,
    'qty' => 2,
]);
```

### Notes

- The destination key should represent array data.
- Dot notation is supported for nested arrays such as `cart.items`.

methods.name: prepend
methods.label: Prepend to Session Array
methods.description: Prepends a value to an array stored in session.
methods.help:
Prepends a value to an array stored in session.

### Example

```php
$session->prepend('breadcrumbs', 'Home');
```

### Notes

- The value is inserted at the beginning of the stored array.

methods.name: all
methods.label: Get All Session Data
methods.description: Returns all ThunderPHP application session data.
methods.help:
Returns all ThunderPHP application session data.

### Example

```php
$data = $session->all();
```

### Notes

- Session data managed by the class is stored under the `THUNDER` root namespace.

methods.name: clear
methods.label: Clear Session Data
methods.description: Clears all ThunderPHP application session data.
methods.help:
Clears all ThunderPHP application session data.

### Example

```php
$session->clear();
```

### Notes

- This clears ThunderPHP application session data. Use `invalidate()` when the complete PHP session must be destroyed.

methods.name: auth
methods.label: Authenticate User
methods.description: Stores a user row in session and can optionally regenerate the session ID.
methods.help:
Stores a user row in session and can optionally regenerate the session ID.

### Example

```php
$session->auth($user_row, true);
```

### Notes

- `user_row` must be one user record represented as an object.
- Set `regenerate` to true after login to regenerate the session ID.

methods.name: logout
methods.label: Log Out User
methods.description: Removes the current user row from session.
methods.help:
Removes the current user row from session.

### Example

```php
$session->logout();
```

### Notes

- The documentation describes this as deleting the user row from session.

methods.name: is_logged_in
methods.label: Is User Logged In
methods.description: Checks whether a current user row exists in session.

methods.name: user
methods.label: Get Current User Data
methods.description: Returns the complete current user object or one requested user column.
methods.help:
Returns the complete current user object or one requested user column.

### Example

```php
$user = $session->user();
$email = $session->user('email');
```

### Notes

- Call without a key for the full user object, or provide a column such as `email`.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.label: Is Current User Admin
methods.description: Checks the current user against the Session class admin mechanism.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.label: Regenerate Session ID
methods.description: Regenerates the PHP session ID.
methods.help:
Regenerates the PHP session ID.

### Example

```php
$session->regenerate();
```

### Notes

- Use after privilege changes or authentication when a new session identifier is required.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.label: Invalidate Session
methods.description: Destroys the session completely.
methods.help:
Destroys the session completely.

### Example

```php
$session->invalidate();
```

### Notes

- This is the destructive lifecycle operation; use `logout()` when only the current user data should be removed.

methods.name: flash
methods.label: Set Flash Message
methods.description: Stores temporary flash data under a key.
methods.help:
Stores temporary flash data under a key.

### Example

```php
$session->flash('success', 'Saved successfully');
```

### Notes

- Flash data is intended for temporary cross-request messages.

methods.name: get_flash
methods.label: Get Flash Message
methods.description: Retrieves flash data for a key.
methods.help:
Retrieves flash data for a key.

### Example

```php
echo $session->get_flash('success');
```

### Notes

- Pair with `has_flash()` when the display logic needs an explicit existence check.

methods.name: has_flash
methods.label: Has Flash Message
methods.description: Checks whether flash data exists for a key.

methods.name: clear_flash
methods.label: Clear Flash Data
methods.description: Clears all flash data.
methods.help:
Clears all flash data.

### Example

```php
$session->clear_flash();
```

### Notes

- Clears every flash entry rather than one named key.

methods.name: set_old
methods.label: Store Old Input
methods.description: Stores form data so it can be recovered on a later request.

methods.name: get_old
methods.label: Get Old Input
methods.description: Retrieves one stored old-input value with a fallback.
methods.help:
Retrieves one stored old-input value with a fallback.

### Example

```php
$email = $session->get_old('email', '');
```

### Notes

- Supply a fallback for fields that were not stored.

methods.name: old
methods.label: Get Old Input (Shortcut)
methods.description: Shortcut for retrieving a stored old-input value.
methods.help:
Shortcut for retrieving a stored old-input value.

### Example

```php
$value = $session->old('email');
```

### Notes

- This is the shorter old-input retrieval helper.

methods.name: clear_old
methods.label: Clear Old Input
methods.description: Clears all stored old-input data.
methods.help:
Clears all stored old-input data.

### Example

```php
$session->clear_old();
```

### Notes

- Call after old form values are no longer needed.

methods.name: increment
methods.label: Increment Session Value
methods.description: Increments a numeric session value and returns the updated value.
methods.help:
Increments a numeric session value and returns the updated value.

### Example

```php
$views = $session->increment('page_views');
```

### Notes

- Useful for page-view counters and other numeric values.

methods.name: decrement
methods.label: Decrement Session Value
methods.description: Decrements a numeric session value and returns the updated value.
methods.help:
Decrements a numeric session value and returns the updated value.

### Example

```php
$remaining = $session->decrement('cart_count');
```

### Notes

- Useful for counts that must be reduced across requests.

methods.name: raw
methods.label: Get Raw Session Data
methods.description: Returns the raw ThunderPHP session data array.
methods.help:
Returns the raw ThunderPHP session data array.

### Example

```php
$data = $session->raw();
```

### Notes

- Returns session data without selecting an individual key.

methods.name: pull_user
methods.label: Pull Current User
methods.description: Pulls the current user value from session.
methods.help:
Pulls the current user value from session.

### Example

```php
$user = $session->pull_user();
```

### Notes

- Use when the current user value needs the class pull behavior rather than a normal `user()` read.

methods.name: message
methods.label: Session Message Helper
methods.description: Sets, reads, or erases a flash-style session message by type.
